datasheets.name: Apothecary Biologis

Each time this unit makes an ingress move (20.04), if every model in this unit has this ability, it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally from all enemy units, even if that is within your opponent’s deployment zone.

datasheets.name: Techmarine
datasheets.legend: Techmarines stride selflessly through oncoming fire to soothe the machine spirits of wounded war engines, deftly peeling back damaged armour plates to repair burnt-out cabling and bending warped panels back into shape with their servoarms and mechadendrites.
datasheets.loadout: This model is equipped with: 1 Forge Bolter; 1 Grav-pistol; 1 Omnissian Power Axe and Servo-arm.

datasheets.name: Vanguard Veteran Squad With Jump Packs
datasheets.legend: On the battlefield, Vanguard Veteran Squads with jump packs are peerless rapid- response troops as well as line-breakers. With great plumes of fire extending behind them they can arrive at the perfect time and place to ensure the decisiveness of an assault or utterly break an enemy incursion.
datasheets.loadout: The Vanguard Veteran Sergeant with Jump Pack is equipped with: 1 Heavy Bolt Pistol; 1 Relic Blade. Every Vanguard Veteran with Jump Pack is equipped with: 1 Heavy Bolt Pistol; 1 Master-crafted Power Weapon.

The Vanguard Veteran Sergeant with Jump Pack can have their Heavy Bolt Pistol replaced with 1 Plasma Pistol.
All models in this unit can each have their Heavy Bolt Pistol replaced with 1 Combat Shield.
For every 5 models in this unit, up to 2 Vanguard Veteran with Jump Pack models can each have their Heavy Bolt Pistol replaced with 1 Plasma Pistol.

datasheets.name: Chief Librarian Mephiston
datasheets.legend: Mephiston is an enormously powerful warrior and psyker. He is the only Blood Angel known to have suppressed the Black Rage, resurrecting from near death with exceptional strength, vigour and speed. Many whisper behind his back, asking what price he paid for such a transformation.
datasheets.loadout: This model is equipped with: 1 Fury of the Ancients; 1 Plasma Pistol; 1 Vitarus.

abilities.description: FIGHTS FIRST24.13Those possessed of lightning-fast reactions may strike before the opponent can react. While every model in a unit has this ability, that unit is a Fights First unit. See the Resolve Fights First Combats step in the Fight phase (12.04).

abilities.name: Lone Operative
abilities.description: LONE OPERATIVE24.24Assassins and other covert agents are difficult to pinpoint in the storm of battle. Unless part of an attached unit, this unit is not visible to enemy models unless they are within 12" of this unit, and it cannot be targeted by [INDIRECT FIRE] weapons unless the attacking model is within 12" of this unit. If this ability takes the form Lone Operative X", unless part of an attached unit, this unit is not visible to enemy models unless they are within X" of this unit, and it cannot be targeted by [INDIRECT FIRE] weapons unless the attacking model is within X" of this unit.

datasheets.name: The Sanguinor
datasheets.legend: The Sanguinor is a mysterious figure who fights only on battlefields of the most paramount importance, when the Blood Angels’ need is greatest. He inspires as much courage in the sons of Sanguinius as he does fear in the enemy, and surges across the field as if he were Sanguinius’ will made manifest.

datasheets.name: Astorath

datasheets.name: Azrael
datasheets.legend: Supreme Grand Master Azrael is a beacon of inspiration to those who follow him, and is paid enormous respect for his ability as a strategist. Until this TRANSPORT has resolved all of its attacks, it has all of those selected weapons in addition to its other weapons. datasheets.name: Chaplain Grimaldus
datasheets.legend: High Chaplain Grimaldus is a beacon of Imperial faith. His fortitude is such that many of his brothers believe him invincible. His Cenobyte Servitors lurch to war at his side, bearing with them holy relics of the faith.

On the battlefield, they are reaping whirlwinds, unstoppable, uncompromising, and armed with a lethal assortment of weapons, and they turn upon the enemy in the Emperor’s name.

datasheets.name: Crusader Squad
datasheets.legend: Crusader Squads storm into battle with bolt rifles blazing and chainswords howling. Initiates aim jets of fire from their pyreblasters or swing crackling power fists into their foes, while hard-eyed Neophytes fight furiously to prove their martial worth under the stem gaze of their mentors.

datasheets.name: Venerable Dreadnought
datasheets.legend: Venerable Dreadnoughts are priceless relics steeped in centuries of battle. The ancient warriors at the heart of each are living legends of the Space Wolves, with wisdom as deep as the ocean and intuition as sharp as krakens’ teeth. Awoken from dormancy, they fight as lords of battle, seemingly stepping from the sagas to kill in the name of Russ.

abilities.name: Deadly Demise
abilities.description: DEADLY DEMISE24.08From detonating ammo stores to corrosive innards or frenzied death throes, some targets are deadly even in defeat. This ability always takes the form Deadly Demise X. Each time a model with this ability is destroyed, after the units embarked within it (if any) have made their emergency disembark moves, roll one D6. On a 6, that model suffers a deadly demise; each unit within 6" of that model suffers a number of mortal wounds denoted by X (if this is a random number, roll separately for each unit within 6").

abilities.name: Kill Team

For the purposes of determining which models in this unit can embark within a Transport, Kill Team Terminator models, Kill Team Outrider models, Kill Team Biker models and models equipped with a jump pack each take up the space of 2 models, but can otherwise embark within any TRANSPORT their unit can embark within, even though similar models in other units have the Terminator, Mounted or Jump Pack keywords. For the purposes of interacting with terrain features, all models in units with this ability are considered INFANTRY models, even though similar models in other units may have the MOUNTED or JUMP PACK keywords. datasheets.name: Captain Titus
datasheets.legend: A relentless champion of Ultramar with a will of unyielding adamant, Captain Demetrian Titus has won countless battles against seemingly impossible odds. detachments.name: Boarding Strike
detachments.legend: Space Marines excel in the sort of fast-paced, ferociously violent battles that erupt during voidship boarding assaults. Moving fast and hitting hard, they swiftly secure enemy vessels, or else sweep impertinent foes from their own warships’ decks.

detachments.name: Pilum Strike Team
detachments.legend: Comprising veterans in the theatre of ship-to-ship void war, pilum strike teams are cast through the void like a spear aboard shrouded boarding torpedoes to infiltrate key enemy warships. Once aboard, the Phobos-armoured Space Marines wage a terror campaign to destabilise the target vessel from within.

detachments.name: Terminator Assault
detachments.legend: The Imperium has no finer or more perfectly suited warriors for cleansing the claustrophobic decks of voidships than Terminators. Each battle-brother is an army unto themself. Their armoured resilience is second to none, while their massive firepower allows them to turn gloomy corridors into killing grounds.

detachments.name: Shield of the Void

detachments.name: Tactical Brethren
detachments.legend: A CORE OF TACTICALLY VERSATILE WARRIORS STRENGTHENS THE SPACE MARINE BATTLE LINE

detachments.name: Ironclad Champions
detachments.legend: THE CHAPTER’S DEATHLESS DREADNOUGHT CHAMPIONS STRIDE OUT TO WAR

detachments.name: Tacticus Firestorm Force
detachments.legend: TACTICUS-ARMOURED WARRIORS LAY DOWN DISCIPLINED FIRE TO DOMINATE THE BATTLEFIELD

enhancements.name: Forged in Battle
enhancements.legend: To this Angel of Death, war is the anvil upon which their strength is wrought. Every battle is seen as a test in which they and their battle-brothers can prove themselves, and the superior craftsmanship of their weapons and armour.
enhancements.description: Adeptus Astartes model only. This unit can ignore modifiers to: BS. WS. Hit rolls.

enhancements.name: Linebreaker Onslaught
enhancements.legend: These battle-brothers excel in bursting from the cover of their transport and straight into the enemy lines.
enhancements.description: Adeptus Astartes Infantry model only. If this unit disembarked this turn: This unit can re-roll charge rolls. Enemy units cannot target this unit with snap shooting attacks.

enhancements.name: Adamantine Mantle
enhancements.legend: Bestowed as a mark of honour, this venerated relic lends an extra layer of armour protection that proves especially useful amidst vicious void war.
enhancements.description: Each time an attack is allocated to the bearer, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

enhancements.name: Venator Omni-auspex
enhancements.legend: Constantly detecting and analysing viable targets, this artefact feeds advanced combat data directly into the bearer’s autosenses.
enhancements.description: Phobos model only. This unit’s attacks that target a hidden unit can: Re-roll wound rolls of 1. Or: If the assault doctrine is active for this unit, re-roll wound rolls of 1 and 2.

enhancements.name: Stormseer's Wisdom
enhancements.legend: The Chapter’s Librarians have made this champion privy to omens of great threats in future wars. Armed with this knowledge, they lead their warriors to war with a boldness that some mistake for recklessness.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This unit can re-roll advance rolls.

enhancements.name: Redoubtable Machine Spirit
enhancements.legend: This ancient war machine has endured millennia of battle, and its belligerent machine spirit has only become more obdurant.
enhancements.description: Adeptus Astartes Vehicle unit only (excluding Dedicated Transport/Fly/Walker units). This unit: Has 5+ InSv. At the end of your Command phase, heals 1 wound.

enhancements.name: Seal of Indomitability
enhancements.legend: This ancient honour is said to fortify the machine spirit of a suit of Terminator plate against even the most dolorous of blows.
enhancements.description: Once per battle, when the bearer’s unit is selected as the target of one or more attacks, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, the bearer has a 3+ invulnerable save.

enhancements.name: Righteous Fervour
enhancements.legend: With their zealous hatred stoked red-hot by furious sermons and inflammatory prayers, Companions of Vehemence are filled with a wrathful vigour. Only the deaths of the God-Emperor’s enemies can assuage their fury, and they will let nothing delay them from unleashing it.
enhancements.description: CRUSADER SQUAD unit only. This unit can re-roll Advance rolls.

enhancements.name: Honour Indefatigable
enhancements.legend: This rare honour badge celebrates a warrior who refuses to give up, even in the face of apparently certain death.
enhancements.description: Gravis model only. (Once per battle, per army) At the end of a phase in which this model is destroyed, roll one D6: On a 2+, set this model back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed, unengaged, with 3 wounds remaining.

enhancements.name: Seal of Shrouding
enhancements.legend: Built into what appears a simple wax purity seal, this device scrambles enemy targeting when the bearer is on the move.
enhancements.description: Phobos model only. Enemy units cannot target this unit with snap shooting attacks.

enhancements.name: Student of the Codex
enhancements.legend: This prodigal officer has focused upon one aspect of the Codex Astartes and means to master its every aspect before moving on to the next.
enhancements.description: Captain model only. The tactical doctrine is active for this unit in addition to any other combat doctrine.

enhancements.name: Blackwing Shroud
enhancements.legend: This mechanical device contains miniaturised refraction fields and electromagnetic interference projectors that distort sensory apparatus, enabling the bearer and their unit to evade detection and infiltrate key positions.
enhancements.description: Adeptus Astartes Infantry model only. This unit has Infiltrators.

enhancements.name: Omni-Structural Auspex
enhancements.legend: A rare device with a potent and knowledgeable machine spirit, this implement analyses the integrity of foes’ armour and isolates weaknesses to exploit.
enhancements.description: In your Shooting phase, after the bearer has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, each time a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES model (excluding Character models) makes an attack that targets that unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

enhancements.name: Howlmaw
enhancements.legend: An ancient hunting horn with a built-in vox amplification unit, this relic’s stirring howl can be heard even through the wild clangour of battle.
enhancements.description: Wolf Priest model only. (Once per turn, per unit) At the start of the fight phase, you can select one enemy unit within 6" of this model. That unit makes a battle-shock roll with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

enhancements.name: Preyslayer
enhancements.legend: Possessed of a ferocious predatory instinct, this warrior leads swift and deadly encirclements and ambushes with peerless skill.
enhancements.description: Adeptus Astartes Infantry model only. This unit can re-roll charge rolls.

enhancements.name: Fervent Exemplars
enhancements.legend: Paragons of their crusade's inexorable wrath, these Sword Brethren have earned a reputation for carving a path to victory through their foes, unable to rest while one enemy yet lives.
enhancements.description: Sword Brethren Squad unit only. This unit has +1 to charge rolls.

enhancements.name: Standard of the Emperor Ascendant
enhancements.legend: This venerable banner was carried in the Great Crusade, and its presence is a constant inspiration.
enhancements.description: Ancient model only. This model has: +1 OC and Ld. Feel No Pain 5+. The following ability: Ancient Exhortation (Once per battle, per army): When this unit is selected to fight, you can use this ability. If you do, this unit’s melee attacks have +1 A until the end of the phase.

enhancements.name: Speartip of the Chapter
enhancements.legend: A veteran of countless boarding strikes, this warrior leads their battle-brothers in a vanguard breach that drives into the foe's heart.
enhancements.description: At the start of the first battle round, the bearer’s unit and up to one other friendly unit within the same Entry Zone can each make a Normal move of up to 6".

enhancements.name: Augury Servo-host
enhancements.legend: This warrior’s auto-senses are linked to a circling host of servo-skulls crafted from the remains of favoured serfs and failed neophytes. Fitted with ocular probes and sensor vanes, they provide the Black Templar with advanced targeting information to pick out the unbelievers who cower in concealment.
enhancements.description: Adeptus Astartes model only. In your Shooting phase, you can select one visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit. That enemy unit cannot have the benefit of cover.

enhancements.name: Supercharged Engines
enhancements.legend: Built from ancient and dimly understood designs, these engines generate incredible power and torque.
enhancements.description: Adeptus Astartes Mounted unit only. This unit can re-roll advance rolls.

enhancements.name: Prescient Flash
enhancements.legend: A flash of foresight and clarity sings through this warrior’s blood and guides his steps into battle.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This unit has Scouts 6".

enhancements.name: Singular Will
enhancements.legend: This warrior lets nothing stand in their way or slow their advance, closing swiftly and relentlessly with their quarry.
enhancements.description: Deathwing model only. When this unit is selected to make a consolidation move, this unit can move up to D3+3".

enhancements.name: Tempered in Battle (Aura)
enhancements.legend: A veteran of the Inner Circle, this warrior inspires those around them to hold the line amidst the heat and chaos of battle.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units within 6" of this model can re-roll leadership rolls.

enhancements.name: Beacon Angelis
enhancements.legend: The Beacon Angelis was devised to guide the Deathwatch to the threshold of the alien adversary. Housed within a reliquary, it calls out to the warriors’ augur arrays with the voices of a hundred electric cherubim, its summons so strong that it draws the righteous unto its locale regardless of what darkness may surround it.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. If this unit is a Kill Team unit, this unit has: Deep Strike. When you target this unit with the Rapid Ingress Stratagem, that use is -1CP.

enhancements.name: The Thief of Secrets
enhancements.legend: The Thief of Secrets is a blade whose machine spirit has an unquenchable thirst for knowledge. It has tasted the vitae of countless alien races, absorbing those liquids through auto-sanctified sanguinator-channels and codifying them through the honeycombed array of logicum cells within. The biological secrets of many xenos races have thus been laid bare, allowing the blade’s user to modulate its power field, the better to slice through chitinous armour, rupture xenoform organs and burn out alien nervous systems.
enhancements.description: WATCH MASTER/CAPTAIN model only. This model has the following weapon:

enhancements.name: Hunter's Guile
enhancements.legend: Adeptus Astartes model only. When both players have deployed their armies, you can redeploy up to three friendly Blood Claws/Thunderwolf Cavalry/Wulfen units. When doing so, you can set those units up in strategic reserves, regardless of how many units are already in strategic reserves.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. When both players have deployed their armies, you can redeploy up to three friendly Blood Claws/Thunderwolf Cavalry/Wulfen units. When doing so, you can set those units up in strategic reserves, regardless of how many units are already in strategic reserves.

enhancements.name: Master-forged Firearms
enhancements.legend: The finest ballistic armaments the Chapter’s artificers can create, these weapons reap a grievous tally of foes.
enhancements.description: Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted model only. This model’s ranged attacks (excluding [Psychic] attacks) have +1 A, S, AP and D.

enhancements.name: Champion of the First Company
enhancements.legend: Few are the enemies this warrior has not faced and bested, and they remember the vulnerabilities of every defeated foe.
enhancements.description: Adeptus Astartes Terminator model only. This unit’s melee attacks have [Lethal Hits].

enhancements.name: Shadow of Abomination
enhancements.legend: Granted a glimmer of foresight by his genetic inheritance, this Son of Sanguinius has identified a foe whose future is drenched in the blood of the Imperium. Such an enemy cannot be allowed to live.
enhancements.description: Adeptus Astartes Jump Pack model only. (once per battle, per army) When this unit is selected to fight you can use this ability. If you do, this model’s melee attacks have +1 D.

enhancements.name: Instinctive Interception
enhancements.legend: Proudly is Sanguinius remembered for his rapid intercession in the protection of his gene-sons. Driven on by death visions, this lost warrior is a tragic monument to such glory.
enhancements.description: Death Company model only. When you target this unit with the Heroic Intervention stratagem, that use is -1 CP.

enhancements.name: Thundercowl Turbines
enhancements.legend: These master-wrought engines from the Dark Ages of Technology churn the gloom emanated by the Ravenwing's reliquaries into a billowing cawl that shrouds their advance, allowing them to strike when the foe least expects.
enhancements.description: Ravenwing Fly/Ravenwing Mounted unit only. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an ingress move.

enhancements.name: Imperium's Sword
enhancements.legend: This champion hurls himself forwards with unbridled ferocity, cutting down the foe like a reaping whirlwind.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This model has the following weapon:

enhancements.name: Martial Paragon
enhancements.legend: Leading his battle-brothers by example, this champion of the Chapter strives to embody the martial teachings of the Codex Astartes.
enhancements.description: Tacticus model only. This unit’s attacks can: Re-roll one hit roll. Re-roll one wound roll.

enhancements.name: Laurels of Vigilance
enhancements.legend: Those awarded this prestigious honour are ever vigilant, responding swiftly and with measured force to enemy threats.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only.(Once per battle round, per army) When you use the Fire Overwatch/Heroic Intervention stratagem, if you target a friendly Adeptus Astartes Battleline unit within 12" of this model with that stratagem, that use is -1 CP.

enhancements.name: Immovable Conquerors
enhancements.legend: Once these Gravis-armoured warriors have planted their feet and braced for battle, no force in the galaxy can move them.
enhancements.description: Gravis unit only. This unit has +1 OC.

enhancements.name: Artificer Sarcophagus
enhancements.legend: Fashioned by an artificer of exceptional skill over an entire lifetime, this sarcophagus resists even the most grievous blows.
enhancements.description: Dreadnought unit only. Attacks that target this unit have -1 D.

enhancements.name: Indefatigable Fortitude
enhancements.legend: Renowned for being a living engine of war, this warrior inspires his comrades to shrug off even the most devastating attacks.
enhancements.description: Gravis model only. Attacks that target this unit with a S greater than this unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.

enhancements.name: Cyber-familiar
enhancements.legend: Hovering high overhead on grav-impellers, this small cyber-creature cogitates emergent threats and alerts its master to tactical openings.
enhancements.description: Tacticus model only. When both players have deployed their armies, you can redeploy up to three friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry units. When doing so, you can set those units up in strategic reserves, regardless of how many units are already in strategic reserves.

enhancements.name: Target Augury Web
enhancements.legend: This spearhead commander uses advanced augmetics to distribute targeting data. With these, they direct the fire of their war engine crews and rouse their machine spirits to operative superiority.
enhancements.description: TECHMARINE model only. In your movement phase, at the start or end of this unit’s move, you can select one friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE model within 3" of this unit. That VEHICLE model’s attacks have [LETHAL HITS] until the start of your next Command phase

enhancements.name: Umbral Raptor
enhancements.legend: This warrior is a solitary predator whose footsteps are all but silent and whose form is one with the shadows.
enhancements.description: Adeptus Astartes infantry model only. This model has: Fights First. Lone Operative.

enhancements.name: Venator Omni-auspex
enhancements.legend: Constantly detecting and analysing viable targets, this artefact feeds advanced combat data directly into the bearer’s autosenses.
enhancements.description: Phobos model only. This unit’s attacks that target a hidden unit can: Re-roll wound rolls of 1. Or: If the assault doctrine is active for this unit, re-roll wound rolls of 1-2.

enhancements.name: Execute and Redeploy
enhancements.legend: This war leader excels in harrying tactics, wielding their strike force like a weapon of utmost stealth and cunning.
enhancements.description: Phobos model only. In your Shooting phase, after this unit has shot, if this unit is unengaged, this unit can make a normal move of up to 6". If it does, this unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.

enhancements.name: Auspex Triangulation Shrines
enhancements.legend: Fitted to the Chapter’s swift grav-speeders, these vigilant devices runelock the positions of enemy forces, laying them bare to the Space Marines’ wrath.
enhancements.description: Adeptus Astartes speeder unit only. At the start of your Shooting phase, select one visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit. That enemy unit is spotted: While a unit is spotted, that unit has +3" detection range.

enhancements.name: Grimnar's Mark
enhancements.legend: This moonsilver wolf-talisman is bestowed by the Great Wolf himself before battle, a mark of favour that fills the bearer with an eagerness to slay the foe.
enhancements.description: Adeptus Astartes Terminator Captain model only. (Once per battle round, per army) You can target this unit with the Rapid Ingress/Heroic Intervention stratagem, regardless of any other uses of that stratagem this phase. If you do: That use is -1CP. That use does not prevent any uses of that stratagem on other units this phase.

enhancements.name: Tactical Insight
enhancements.legend: This champion understands the deeper flow of battle, and is always prepared to discern the course of action that will bring assured victory.
enhancements.description: Captain model only. The tactical doctrine is active for this unit in addition to any other combat doctrine.

enhancements.name: Furious Assault
enhancements.legend: Bellicose temperament and advanced training combine to make this unit especially terrifying on the charge.
enhancements.description: Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit only. This unit’s melee attacks have [Sustained Hits 1: non-Monster/Vehicle].

enhancements.name: Nightforged Battery (Upgarde)
enhancements.legend: Use of these relic plasma storm batteries is granted only by dispensation of the Master of the Rock. They unleash devastating toroids of searing plasma, while their venting subsystems are known to be especially vigilant.
enhancements.description: Land Speeder Vengeance unit only. This unit can re-roll: Rolls to determine the A of a weapon. Hazard rolls.

enhancements.name: Venerable Champion (Aura)
enhancements.legend: Having won innumerable triumphs, this timeless warrior confers the boon of their martial wisdom upon their battle-brothers.
enhancements.description: Dreadnought unit only. While a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted unit is within 6" of this unit, that unit’s attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1.

enhancements.name: On the Archtraitor's Bridge
enhancements.legend: Lost to a memory shard of the Primarch, in this warrior's mind, he has entered the Archtraitor's sanctum, and all that stands between him and Horus is a host of massing traitors.
enhancements.description: Death Company model only. This model’s melee attacks have +2 A.

enhancements.name: Angelic Executioner
enhancements.legend: This deadly duellist leads his battle-brothers in masterful strikes capable of carving through their armoured or swarming foes with breathtaking fluidity.
enhancements.description: Adeptus Astartes Jump Pack model only. When this unit is selected to fight, this unit’s melee attacks have: [LETHAL HITS]. Or: [SUSTAINED HITS 1]

enhancements.name: Blazing Icon
enhancements.legend: What was before merely a decorative blood drop pendant now shines with a seemingly miraculous light as bright as any star. The foe are forced to avert their gaze from its wrathful magnificence.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Enemy units cannot target this unit with snap shooting attacks.

enhancements.name: Consecrating Aura
enhancements.legend: The piety and honour of this warrior can be felt wherever he fights. His presence rouses the ardent souls of the Black Templars, warding Sigismund’s heirs from the blasphemy of the unbeliever.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This unit has 5+ InSv.

enhancements.name: Inheritors of Sigismund
enhancements.legend: These warrior elites have achieved feats of bloody slaughter against the most deadly of the God-Emperor's foes, executing them in displays of such blisteringly swift attacks that it is clear they share a sliver of Sigismund's own skill.
enhancements.description: Sword Brethren Squad unit only. This unit has Fights First.

enhancements.name: Oathbound Exemplar
enhancements.legend: With a ceaseless and booming oratory, this commander exhorts his warriors in their duty to the Emperor. Honour, he declaims, must be pursued relentlessly.
enhancements.description: Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit only. When this unit is selected to make an advance/fall-back move, that advance/fall-back move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to start an action.

enhancements.name: Chogorian Huntmaster
enhancements.legend: This mounted huntsman knows well the importance of manoeuvre, outflanking the enemy and ambushing unsuspecting foes from the flanks and rear, the better to land the killing blow.
enhancements.description: Adeptus Astartes Mounted/Speeder unit only. When this unit is selected to make an ingress move, treat the current battle round number as being one higher than it actually is.

enhancements.name: Adamantine Mantle
enhancements.legend: This flowing cloak or finely wrought tabard is laced through with threads of braided adamantine. When combined with armour and energy fields, it has been shown time and again that these symbols of office are proof against even the very strongest attacks.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Attacks allocated to this model have -1 D.

enhancements.name: Wolf-Touched
enhancements.legend: Whilst the Canis Helix has yet to overcome this champion fully, it is stirred to life by the thrill of battle and the scent of blood.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This unit has: Wulfen. +2" M.
enhancements.supportLeader: LEADER: WULFEN, WULFEN WITH STORM SHIELDS

enhancements.name: Spearpoint War Leader
enhancements.legend: Once the enemy are sighted, this warrior leads the attack from the very front, striving to be first in amongst the foe’s ranks.
enhancements.description: Tacticus model only. This unit has Scouts 6".

enhancements.name: Clavitine Reliquary
enhancements.legend: A timeless and unique example of Chapter artifice, this device rapidly synchronises with the data spirits of locking devices and renders them quiescent.
enhancements.description: In your Movement phase, each time the bearer is selected to make a Normal or Advance move, if it is within 1" of a Hatchway, it can attempt to operate that Hatchway. If it does, it cannot attempt to operate a Hatchway again this turn.

enhancements.name: Honour of Vigilance
enhancements.legend: A savant of applied firepower, this warrior ensures their comrades’ big guns are always optimally positioned and targeted.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This unit’s ranged attacks have [Lethal Hits]. If the devastator doctrine is active for this unit, this unit can re-roll advance rolls.

enhancements.name: Tempered in Battle (Aura)
enhancements.legend: The stonewrought reputation and unfaltering determination of this commander serve as a linchpin for even the most hard-pressed strike force.
enhancements.description: Tacticus model only. Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units within 6" of this model can re-roll leadership rolls.

enhancements.name: Gunnery Honours
enhancements.legend: The crew of this war machine demonstrate exemplary gunnery and have earned the highest honours for their craft.
enhancements.description: Adeptus Astartes Vehicle unit only (excluding Dedicated Transport/Fly/Walker units). This unit’s ranged attacks have [Heavy].

enhancements.name: A Giant Amongst Giants
enhancements.legend: Likened to a walking pinnacle of Fenrisian granite come to life, this hulking champion is an echo of Russ himself.
enhancements.description: Adeptus Astartes Infantry model only. This model has +2 W. This model’s melee attacks have +1 S.

enhancements.name: Beacon Angelis
enhancements.legend: The Beacon Angelis was devised to guide the Deathwatch to the threshold of the alien adversary. Housed within a reliquary, it calls out to the warriors’ augur arrays with the voices of a hundred electric cherubim, its summons so strong that it draws the righteous unto its locale regardless of what darkness may surround it.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. If this unit is a Kill Team unit, this unit has: Deep Strike. When you target this unit with the Rapid Ingress Stratagem, that use is -1CP.

enhancements.name: Armour of Antoninus
enhancements.legend: Originally worn by a storied Captain of the Ultramarines’ First Company, this artificer armour is bestowed by the Chapter Master himself upon a worthy wearer.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This model has: 2+ Sv. Feel No Pain 5+.

enhancements.name: Castellum Omnivox
enhancements.legend: This unique vox-and-augur augmetic provides the bearer with unparalleled tactical data vital to coordinating an aggressive defence in battle.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit only. When this unit makes a advance/fall-back move, that move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to start an action.

enhancements.name: Corporeum Reliquary
enhancements.legend: This archeotech teleportation stabiliser is unique, a relic of Dark Age technology that spirits its bearer swiftly through the tides of the Warp.
enhancements.description: Adeptus Astartes Terminator model only. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an ingress move.

enhancements.name: Narthecis Gauntlet
enhancements.legend: This rare supplementary medicae suite allows this Apothecary to provide support to their battle-brothers despite being outfitted for a different role.
enhancements.description: Apothecary Biologis model only. in your Command phase, this unit heals D3+1 wounds.

enhancements.name: Adept of the Omnissiah
enhancements.legend: This battle-brother is steeped in hidden technological rites. Should their armoured charges be threatened, a burst of arcane Binharic screed can rouse their machine spirits to vigilance.
enhancements.description: TECHMARINE model only. (Once per battle round, per army) When an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit within 6" of this unit, you can use this ability. If you do, that VEHICLE unit has Feel No Pain 5+ until that enemy unit has attacked.

enhancements.name: Lord of the Ravenwing
enhancements.legend: This commander has mastered the art of cavalry combat, instinctively noticing the opportune position to strike and navigating the chaos of battle with preternatural precision.
enhancements.description: Ravenwing model only. This unit can re-roll charge rolls.

enhancements.name: Relentless Advance
enhancements.legend: Ever on the move, this warrior leads his battle-brothers in a tireless crusade across the battlefields of the 41st millennium.
enhancements.description: Gravis model only. This unit has Scouts 5".

enhancements.name: Champion of the Deathwing
enhancements.legend: Even amongst the elite of the Unforgiven, this warrior is a paragon of duty and martial might.
enhancements.description: Deathwing model only. This unit’s attacks that target an enemy unit within range of your vowed objective have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

enhancements.name: Laurels of Triumph
enhancements.legend: A rare honour, the Laurels of Triumph mark out a truly accomplished warrior even amongst the Angels of Death.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This model’s melee attacks have: +1 S and AP. Or: If the assault doctrine is active for this unit, +2 S and AP.

enhancements.name: Void Warrior
enhancements.legend: Having mastered the arts of shipboard warfare over many battles, this warrior moves swiftly through them and strikes with unerring skill.
enhancements.description: You can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for the bearer. In addition, the bearer is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

enhancements.name: Tolorek Data Djinn
enhancements.legend: Gifted by the Tech-Priests of Tolorek for the cleansing of Ultramar, this powerful cyberspirit uses brute force technoscreed when entreated to overwhelm the systems of enemy ships, conquering them and yoking their protocols to the bearer's will.
enhancements.description: In your Command phase, select one objective marker that you control and is within range of the bearer. Roll one D6: on a 2+, that objective marker is Secured by your army.

enhancements.name: Resolute
enhancements.legend: Allowing nothing to bar his path, this champion of the Chapter ploughs a bloody path through the foe.
enhancements.description: The bearer is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. In addition, Desperate Escape tests taken for the bearer are automatically passed, and each time the bearer makes a Fall Back move, it can move through enemy models as if they were not there.

enhancements.name: Damocles-class Uplink
enhancements.legend: This portable strat-shrine plugs directly into the bearer’s armour, enhancing their command and control abilities.
enhancements.description: Captain model only. In your Movement phase, if this unit is embarked within a Transport unit, you can select one friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit within 6" of that TRANSPORT unit and select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for that INFANTRY unit.

enhancements.name: Incendiary Animus
enhancements.legend: This inspirational warrior exudes fierce contempt and loathing for the Emperor’s foes, inciting such apoplectic revulsion in their battle-brothers as to drive their blows with vicious strength.
enhancements.description: Chaplain/Judiciar model only. This unit’s melee attacks have +1 S.

enhancements.name: The Tome of Ectoclades
enhancements.legend: This grimoire, bound in the skin of the alien, holds the most powerful truths the Deathwatch have uncovered about their foes - whether xenos or those who harbour them - arming them with the best tactics and strategies to use against such threats.
enhancements.description: WATCH MASTER/CAPTAIN model only. (Once per battle, per army) In your Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, the assault doctrine, devastator doctrine and tactical doctrine are active for this unit until the start of your next Command phase.

enhancements.name: Hunter's Instincts
enhancements.legend: Those who master the Path of Ambush guide their forces to launch surprise assaults on the enemy with the precise timing of true hunters.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an ingress move.

enhancements.name: Chariots of the Storm
enhancements.legend: This dedicated flight of gunships attends the Great Wolf and his packs, and can be called in to rapidly reposition his forces in the moments before battle is joined.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. When both players have deployed their armies, you can redeploy up to three friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units. When doing so, you can set those units up in strategic reserves, regardless of how many units are already in strategic reserves.

enhancements.name: Deathwing Assault
enhancements.legend: A veteran inductee of the Inner Circle, this champion has served amongst the Deathwing for centuries and become an unmatched master of teleportarium insertions.
enhancements.description: Deathwing model with the Deep Strike ability only. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an ingress move.

enhancements.name: War Tempered Artifice
enhancements.legend: Having laboured long in the Chapter’s forges, this warrior smith has crafted his personal armaments. Each weapon is a masterwork tool of death-dealing, wrought with care and strength, and embellished with the icons of their maker’s brotherhood.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This model’s melee attacks have: +1 S. +1 D.

enhancements.name: Adept of the Codex
enhancements.legend: An ardent student of the Codex Astartes, this commander epitomises its tactical genius.
enhancements.description: Captain model only. The tactical doctrine is active for this unit in addition to any other combat doctrine.

enhancements.name: Ordained Sacrifice
enhancements.legend: Knowing only too well the desperate and vital nature of the battle before him, this scion of Sanguinius echoes his Primarch’s resolute determination to fight on even beyond what seems the doors of certain death.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. (Once per battle, per army) At the end of a phase in which this model is destroyed, roll one D6: On a 2+, set this model back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed, unengaged, with 3 wounds remaining.

enhancements.name: Defensive Mastery
enhancements.legend: Few officers of the Chapter can match this commander’s talent for cunning defensive troop dispositions.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. When both players have deployed their armies, you can redeploy up to three friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry units. When doing so, you can set those units up in strategic reserves, regardless of how many units are already in strategic reserves.

enhancements.name: Oath of Macragge
enhancements.legend: Amongst the most solemn and binding oaths an Ultramarine can swear, it is a rare honour to enter battle with these words affixed to their armour.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This model’s melee attacks have: +1 S and AP. Or: If the assault doctrine is active for this unit, +2 S and AP.

enhancements.name: Hunter's Eye
enhancements.legend: This augmetic eye enhances the user’s visual spectrum, enabling them to pinpoint heat signatures and cogitate appropriate firing solutions.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This unit’s ranged attacks: Have [IGNORES COVER]. Have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

enhancements.name: Zealous Vanguard
enhancements.legend: This warrior is an unstoppable crusader whose hearts burn like twin pyres of eager zeal. Ever at the forefront of combat, he leads his warriors as the tip of the crusade’s blade.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This unit has Scouts 6".

enhancements.name: Spearpoint Paragon
enhancements.legend: Decades of service within the White Scars First Company have helped this superlative warrior master the violent arts of high-speed combat.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This model’s melee attacks have: +1 S and AP. Or: If this unit made a charge move this turn, +2 S and AP.

enhancements.name: Immolator
enhancements.legend: Steeped in the Promethean Cult, this battle-brother wields the flamer with unparalleled mastery, turning the battlefield into a burning pyre for the corpses of his foes.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This unit’s [TORRENT] weapons have +1 A.

enhancements.name: The Flesh is Weak
enhancements.legend: The injuries of past battles have seen this warrior heavily rebuilt with ultra-durable cybernetic limbs and organs that render them extremely difficult to kill.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This model: Has +1 T. Has Feel No Pain 5+.

enhancements.name: Osseus Key (Aura)
enhancements.legend: The ancient clavis known as the Osseus Key is said to be the most powerful of its kind. Where other such devices are made from sanctified platinum, the Osseus Key is made from the hand and finger bones of deceased Imperial Fists heroes that fought in the Horus Heresy, scrimshawed with inhuman care and imbued with the fiercest machine spirits of the age. No portal can bar its bearer from entry, and no xenos machine can stand before his wrath.
enhancements.description: WATCH MASTER/TECHMARINE model only. While an enemy VEHICLE unit is within 6" of this model, that enemy unit’s attacks have -1 A.

enhancements.name: Spy-skull Data Link
enhancements.legend: Several artificer-crafted and heavily shrouded servo-skulls are tethered to this device, their linked visual feeds making the bearer nigh impossible to evade.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit only. This unit’s ranged weapons have [IGNORES COVER].

enhancements.name: Ancient Weapons
enhancements.legend: The vaults of the Dark Angels contain many relics from Humanity’s distant past. This soldier has been granted the honour of bearing such a weapon to battle.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This model’s melee attacks: Have +2 S. Have +1 AP.

enhancements.name: Skjald's Foretelling
enhancements.legend: Great deeds have been prophesied for this champion, such that those who fight alongside him do so all the harder as they play out the self-fulfilling prophecy.
enhancements.description: Wolf Guard Battle Leader model only. This unit’s melee attacks have [Lance].

enhancements.name: Veteran of Behemoth
enhancements.legend: Having battled the Tyranid swarms since their first galactic invasion, this veteran officer knows well the benefit of efficient and overwhelming firepower.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This unit’s ranged attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

enhancements.name: Coronal Susurrant
enhancements.legend: This wreath of circuitry from the Dark Age of Technology forces a whispering white noise into enemy minds and broadcasts, impeding communications and interrupting the chain of command.
enhancements.description: Phobos model only. Each enemy unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) engaged with this unit cannot be targeted by controlling player stratagems.

enhancements.name: Artificer Armour
enhancements.legend: Crafted by the Chapter’s finest artificers, this suit of armour provides superior protection.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This model has: 2+ Sv. Feel No Pain 5+.

enhancements.name: Unto Death
enhancements.legend: Just as his Primarch before him, this warrior has foreseen his impending doom and goes towards it regardless, desperate to land a telling blow upon the foe before death claims him.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. (Once per battle, per army) In your Command phase you can use this ability. If you do, until the end of the turn this unit can: Re-roll advance rolls. Re-roll charge rolls.

stratagems.name: INSTANT OF GRACE
stratagems.legend: In this most desperate moment of need, a lone battle-brother rises to the challenge as a true inheritor of the Angel’s legacy.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Command phase. TARGET: One friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit. EFFECT: Your unit has CHARACTER until the start of your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: STRIKE NOW FOR GLORY
stratagems.legend: Knowing instinctively that the pivotal moment has arrived, these battle-brothers aim and hammer their foes with unrelenting volleys.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase when a friendly Adeptus Astartes unit is selected to attack. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

stratagems.name: FOCUSED FURY
stratagems.legend: Keeping the beast within under tight control, the Blood Angels nonetheless tap into that inner rage and shackle it to their precisely aimed blows.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks: Have [LETHAL HITS]. Or: If your unit is a Character unit, have [LETHAL HITS], [LANCE].

stratagems.name: IN THE SHADOW OF GREAT WINGS
stratagems.legend: The enemy are engulfed in a soul-deep shadow for just a moment, as though mighty wings have spread above them and marred their vision with occluding darkness.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Adeptus Astartes Character unit. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER unit. EFFECT: Your unit has: Stealth. -3" detection range.

stratagems.name: UNTO THE BURNING SKIES
stratagems.legend: In the face of encroaching doom, as the world seems to burn around them, these scions of Sanguinius leap high into the tormented heavens, ready to strike down with vengeful fury upon the enemy teeming below.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase. TARGET: One friendly The Sanguinor/unengaged Adeptus Astartes Jump Pack unit. EFFECT: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

stratagems.name: MEASURED STRATEGIST
stratagems.legend: Stern and level-headed, this Blood Angels commander is a beacon of composure amidst the tempest of his brothers’ fury, providing much-needed tactical guidance for his impetuous battle-brothers.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Command phase. TARGET: One friendly Adeptus Astartes Character unit. EFFECT: Select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: DUTY IN DEATH
stratagems.legend: Imminent death does not prevent a Space Marine from enacting their final justice upon the Emperor’s foes.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit. EFFECT: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +1 to that roll if the assault doctrine is active for your unit: On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

stratagems.name: GENE-WROUGHT MIGHT
stratagems.legend: Space Marines are blessed with incredible strength.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have: [Lance]. Or: If the assault doctrine is active for your unit, [Lance] and +1 AP.

stratagems.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
stratagems.legend: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit. EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
stratagems.legend: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit. EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: SITE-TO-SITE TELEPORTATION
stratagems.legend: Site-to-site battlefield teleportation is a rare capability indeed, used only by the Deathwatch in extreme situations.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase. TARGET: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit. EFFECT: Place your unit in strategic reserves. If your unit has Kill Team, your unit has Deep Strike until the end of your next Movement phase.

stratagems.name: ADAPTIVE TACTICS
stratagems.legend: Only a truly versatile approach to warfare allows the tactical genius of the Deathwatch to best the myriad xenos foes they face.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Command phase. TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit. EFFECT: Select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: DRAGONFIRE ROUNDS
stratagems.legend: Dragonfire rounds are designed to explode just before contact, saturating foes in cover with searing gas and flames.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase when a KILL TEAM unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That KILL TEAM unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks: Can re-roll wound rolls of 1. Have [IGNORES COVER].

stratagems.name: HELLFIRE ROUNDS
stratagems.legend: Hellfire rounds douse their targets in voracious acids that are utterly lethal to organic life.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase when a KILL TEAM unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That KILL TEAM unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks (excluding [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] attacks) have [ANTI-non-VEHICLE 4+].

stratagems.name: KRAKEN ROUNDS
stratagems.legend: Kraken rounds utilise adamantine cores and improved propellants to penetrate the thickest hide.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase when a KILL TEAM unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That KILL TEAM unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks: Have +6" R. Have +1 S.

stratagems.name: COURAGE AND HONOUR!
stratagems.legend: Roaring their famed battle cry, the Ultramarines hurl themselves into the fight, striving all the harder to prevail beneath the unwavering eye of their Chapter Master.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [Lance].

stratagems.name: TACTICAL FORESIGHT
stratagems.legend: With the enemy’s countermeasures and responses predicted and allowed for in advance, the Ultramarines can weather their most ferocious attacks.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit. EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit with a S greater than this unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.

stratagems.name: PRACTICAL TACTICS
stratagems.legend: After rapidly making a theoretical assessment of the foes’ probable next moves, the Ultramarines apply practical repositioning to counter them.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted unit. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit. EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: ULTRAMARIAN ADAPTIVITY
stratagems.legend: No Chapter’s warriors know better the breadth - theoretical and practical - of the Codex Astartes’ teachings, and how these can and should be adapted to ensure victory.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Command phase. TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit. EFFECT: Select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: EXEMPLARY VIGILANCE
stratagems.legend: Long have the Ultramarines guarded both Ultramar and the wider Imperium. No foe can hide from their vengeful gaze or evade the reach of their wrath.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].

stratagems.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
stratagems.legend: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit. EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: CERAMITE BULWARK
stratagems.legend: The Space Marines present a wall of ceramite and plasteel shoulder guards to the breach as they force passage through.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase. TARGET: One Adeptus Astartes Battleline unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase. EFFECT: Select any number of models in your unit. Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of melee weapons equipped by the selected models and each time you select targets for attacks made by those models, they must target an enemy unit that is wholly on the opposite side of a Hatchway from them.

stratagems.name: IN THE EMPEROR’S NAME
stratagems.legend: Space Marines will suffer any hardship and endure the savagery of the most monstrous foes to see their duty done.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets. TARGET: One Adeptus Astartes Battleline unit from your army that is within range of an objective marker and was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

stratagems.name: DUTY AND DEFIANCE
stratagems.legend: Even when wounded unto death, still the Adeptus Astartes fight on in hopes their final efforts will spell the difference between defeat and victory.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets. TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if your unit has the Battleline keyword: on a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.name: VOX-AMPLIFIED ROAR
stratagems.legend: In the echoing confines of a voidship, the deafening battle cries of the Space Marines evoke terror in the foe.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Charge phase, just after an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army declares a charge. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit. EFFECT: Each target of that charge must take a Battle-shock test.

stratagems.name: STAND TO THE END
stratagems.legend: Aware of how vital it is that the defence line holds, these warriors fight even to their last breath.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units). TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit. EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls. Or: If your unit is entrenched, attacks that target your unit have -1 to wound rolls.

stratagems.name: UNYIELDING MIGHT
stratagems.legend: Knowing that this strategically vital site must be secure for the defence lines to hold, Space Marines stand indomitable in the face of the foe.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Command phase. TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit that is within range of an objective. EFFECT: Your unit has +1 OC until the end of the turn.

stratagems.name: AUGMENTED TARGETING
stratagems.legend: Auto-sense targeting subroutines specially adapted for defensive fire patterns aid these warriors’ aim.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to attack. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks have: [LETHAL HITS]. Or: [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. Or: If your unit is entrenched, [LETHAL HITS] and [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

stratagems.name: ESTABLISH SUPREMACY
stratagems.legend: Steadfast and determined, the Imperial Fists favour methodical advances, securing and consolidating positions to establish battlefield dominance before turning their attention to the elimination of remaining foes.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly entrenched ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is selected to make a consolidation move. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit. EFFECT: You can select the objective consolidation mode for that consolidation move, regardless of that consolidation move’s Before Moving restrictions. Designer’s Note: This means your unit can move out of engagement range with enemy units, provided it meets the conditions of the objective consolidation mode.

stratagems.name: PRIORITY STRIKE
stratagems.legend: Eliminating key enemy assets is crucial to stalling then reversing the foe’s momentum.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted unit is selected to attack. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks that target a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit, have +1 to wound rolls.

stratagems.name: EVASIVE REPOSITIONING
stratagems.legend: Codex doctrine when conducting an aggressive defence is to swiftly take up new positions whenever the foe finds your range.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot. TARGET: One friendly unengaged Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted unit that lost a wound as a result of those attacks. EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D6". Or: If your unit is entrenched, your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3". Your unit is not able to embark within a TRANSPORT until the end of the turn.

stratagems.name: CHAMPION'S GUIDANCE
stratagems.legend: A paragon of Fenrisian savagery, this champion guides his warriors with confidence and precision.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Character unit is selected to fight. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1 and wound rolls of 1.

stratagems.name: BIRTH OF A SAGA
stratagems.legend: Heroes are forged in the heat of battle, rising from obscurity to become the warriors of epic sagas.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Command phase. TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit (excluding Monster/Vehicle units). EFFECT: Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit has CHARACTER.

stratagems.name: HEROIC RESOLVE
stratagems.legend: This warrior’s indomitable fortitude is the stuff of legend, galvanizing his pack to remain standing before an avalanche of incoming attacks.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Adeptus Astartes Character unit. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER unit. EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 D until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: SKYBORNE SURVEILLANCE
stratagems.legend: The auspicators of the Ravenwing are sleepless, and from ideal hunting vantages, there is nowhere the foe can hide for long.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Ravenwing Fly unit has shot. TARGET: That RAVENWING FLY unit. EFFECT: Visible enemy units within 6" of your unit have +3" detection range.

stratagems.name: WE ARE VENGEANCE
stratagems.legend: The Ravenwing's aerial assets are capable of swift and reactive manoeuvring to new firing positions, ensuring opportunities for rapid vengeance.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged Ravenwing Fly unit has shot. TARGET: That RAVENWING FLY unit. EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: WINGS OF SHADOW
stratagems.legend: Through subtle manoeuvring and empowered cameleoline armour, the swiftest of the Ravenwing evade attempts to bring their hunt to an end.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Ravenwing Fly/Mounted unit. TARGET: That RAVENWING FLY/MOUNTED unit. EFFECT: Your unit has Stealth.

stratagems.name: DRAGONFIRE ROUNDS
stratagems.legend: Dragonfire rounds are designed to explode just before contact, saturating foes in cover with searing gas and flames.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase when a KILL TEAM unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That KILL TEAM unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks: Can re-roll wound rolls of 1. Have [IGNORES COVER].

stratagems.name: KRAKEN ROUNDS
stratagems.legend: Kraken rounds utilise adamantine cores and improved propellants to penetrate the thickest hide.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase when a KILL TEAM unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That KILL TEAM unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have: Have +6" R. Have +1 S.

stratagems.name: BLACKSTAR EXTRACTION
stratagems.legend: Swooping low with transport bays yawning wide, Corvus Blackstar gunships extract Deathwatch warriors from the battlefield and convey them to locations where their lethal talents are most required.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase. TARGET: One friendly unengaged KILL TEAM unit. EFFECT: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

stratagems.name: HELLFIRE ROUNDS
stratagems.legend: Hellfire rounds douse their targets in voracious acids that are utterly lethal to organic life.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase when a KILL TEAM unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That KILL TEAM unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks (excluding [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] attacks) have [ANTI-non-VEHICLE 4+].

stratagems.name: HAIL OF VENGEANCE
stratagems.legend: Space Marines’ incredible battlefield awareness enables them to instinctively identify the origin of any enemy fire and punish their attackers.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot, if those attacks destroyed a model in a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit. EFFECT: Your unit shoots using normal shooting, but while doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.

stratagems.name: STORM OF FIRE
stratagems.legend: There is no escaping the wrath of the Space Marines, and they use their weapons to bring swift death to their foes wherever they may hide.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have: [Ignores Cover]. Or: If the devastator doctrine is active for your unit, [Ignores Cover] and +1 AP.

stratagems.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
stratagems.legend: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit. EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: JUDGEMENT OF THE GOLDEN HOST
stratagems.legend: The meteoric impact of the Sanguinary Guard is an unavoidable judgement on those who have incurred the Chapter's wrath.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Charge phase, when a friendly Sanguinary Guard unit form your army ends a charge move. TARGET: That SANGUINARY GUARD unit. EFFECT: Select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. Roll one D6 for each model in your unit engaged with that enemy unit: For each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

stratagems.name: INEXORABLE VALOUR
stratagems.legend: Ever reaching for the heights of exemplary valour instilled in their forebears by Sanguinius, the golden host seize every opportunity to claim positions from which to strike anew.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit that was engaged with a friendly Sanguinary Guard unit ends a fall-back move, if that SANGUINARY GUARD unit is unengaged. TARGET: That SANGUINARY GUARD unit. EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: BLINDING BLURS OF VENGEANCE
stratagems.legend: When they power forward in rapid leaps, the glare emitted by their jump packs' nacelles reflecting from the mirrored gleam of their armour, the Sanguinary Guard seem to glow with a blinding radiance few can look upon.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Sanguinary Guard unit. TARGET: That SANGUINARY GUARD unit. EFFECT: Your unit has: Stealth. -3" detection range.

stratagems.name: AVOWED DESTRUCTION
stratagems.legend: The Black Templars will see their oaths upheld at any cost. Any foe with the temerity to impede them in this goal must be put mercilessly to the sword.
stratagems.description: WHEN: The Fight phase, when a friendly CRUSADER SQUAD unit is selected to fight. TARGET: That CRUSADER SQUAD unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks: Have [LETHAL HITS]. Or: Have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

stratagems.name: ANGELS DEFIANT
stratagems.legend: All too aware of their vital role in holding the foe at bay, these battle-brothers refuse to yield to even the most grievous of wounds.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly CRUSADER SQUAD unit. TARGET: That CRUSADER SQUAD unit. EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.

stratagems.name: DOCTRINAL FLEXIBILITY
stratagems.legend: For all their zealous fury, the Black Templars are Space Marines still, capable of adapting their strategies in the midst of battle to ensure the foe’s destruction.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Command phase. TARGET: One friendly Crusader Squad unit. EFFECT: Select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: IMMOLATION PROTOCOLS
stratagems.legend: Salvo after salvo of burning promethium unleashed in synchronised waves will leave almost any foe as smouldering ash.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes infantry unit is selected to attack. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged [TORRENT] attacks have +1 AP.

stratagems.name: FORGED IN FIRE
stratagems.legend: The Salamanders are masters of the flamer, wielding such weapons with supreme precision and utilising them even in the press of melee combat.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly engaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s Torrent weapons: Do not have [Blast]. Have [Close-Quarters]. Have +1 A.

stratagems.name: CRUCIBLE OF BATTLE
stratagems.legend: Only where the enemy can be faced eye to eye can a Space Marine be truly tested.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes infantry unit is selected to attack an enemy unit within 6". TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks can: Re-roll hit rolls of 1. Re-roll wound rolls of 1.

stratagems.name: BURNING VENGEANCE
stratagems.legend: To open fire on warriors of the Salamanders is merely to invite one’s own swift destruction.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot a friendly Adeptus Astartes Transport unit. TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit embarked within that ADEPTUS ASTARTES TRANSPORT unit. EFFECT: Your ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit can: Make a disembark move. Shoot using normal shooting, but when doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.

stratagems.name: BLAZING EARTH
stratagems.legend: When faced with an onrushing horde, the Forgefather’s warriors set fire to the earth beneath their feet, impeding their advance and throwing them into confusion.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase. TARGET: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit equipped with one or more Torrent/Melta weapons. EFFECT: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. That enemy unit has -1 to charge rolls.

stratagems.name: WRATH AND RUIN
stratagems.legend: Having drawn their enemies in, Space Marine battle-brothers fall back and open fire at point-blank range before thundering forward to put any survivors to death.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Command phase. TARGET: One friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit. EFFECT: The assault doctrine or tactical doctrine is active for your unit, until the start of your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: STORM AND SECURE
stratagems.legend: The advanced mechanised assault tactics employed by this force allow ground to be seized rapidly while on the move.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your Movement phase. TARGET: One friendly Adeptus Astartes Transport unit that has an Adeptus Astartes Battleline unit embarked within it. EFFECT: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.

stratagems.name: DUTY IS NEVER DONE
stratagems.legend: There is no time to rest upon laurels while any portion of the Emperor’s realm remains in enemy hands.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of the Fight phase. TARGET: One friendly unengaged Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit that was eligible to fight this phase, is wholly within 6" of a friendly Transport unit, and is eligible to embark within that TRANSPORT unit. EFFECT: Your unit embarks within that TRANSPORT unit.

stratagems.name: AGGRESSIVE DISEMBARKATION
stratagems.legend: Bursting out of their transport, the Space Marines are already on the move before their foes can react.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit embarked within a Transport is selected to move. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit. EFFECT: While making that move, each model in your unit can be set up within the set-up distance of that TRANSPORT. This allows you to set up your unit within the set-up distance of your TRANSPORT, instead of wholly within that distance.

stratagems.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
stratagems.legend: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit. EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: A WORTHY DEATH
stratagems.legend: Those Space Marines who specialise in close assault are ready to fight to their last breath and beyond to cut down more foes.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit. EFFECT: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6: On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

stratagems.name: RESPONSIVE TACTICS
stratagems.legend: Space Marines know precisely when to give ground to leave enemies floundering, before surging back and driving them from the field in disarray.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted unit. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit. EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D6".

stratagems.name: STORM OF DEVASTATION
stratagems.legend: Masters of the art of long-ranged warfare, these warriors unleash utter devastation upon their enemies.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].

stratagems.name: ADAPTIVE STRATEGY
stratagems.legend: The tenets of the Codex Astartes allow for unorthodox use of combat tactics and the employment of divergent doctrines if doing so will lead to victory.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Command phase. TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit. EFFECT: Select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: MIGHT OF ANGELS
stratagems.legend: Relentless assault training allows these warriors to focus their already impressive might into a truly devastating close-quarters onslaught.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [Lance].

stratagems.name: ANNIHILATING FORCE
stratagems.legend: Knowing well their duty to shatter the foe’s lines, these warriors strike with devastating strength.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly Gravis unit is selected to attack. TARGET: That GRAVIS unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks have [Lethal Hits].

stratagems.name: PURGATION PUSH
stratagems.legend: Gravis assault tactics stipulate a relentless advance coupled with unfaltering firepower.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Gravis unit has shot. TARGET: That GRAVIS unit. EFFECT: If your unit is unengaged, your unit can make a normal move of up to 5", and must end that move within range of an objective. Your unit is not eligible to declare a charge or embark within a Transport until the end of the turn.

stratagems.name: ARMOURED IMPACT
stratagems.legend: Throwing their armoured mass into an assault, a Space Marine in Gravis armour can crush and trample their foe.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Charge phase, when a friendly Gravis unit ends a charge move. TARGET: That GRAVIS unit. EFFECT: When your unit ends a charge move, you can select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. If you do, roll one D6 for each model in your unit engaged with that enemy unit: For each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

stratagems.name: SUPPRESSION VOLLEYS
stratagems.legend: Laying down hails of heavy fire, these warriors pin or drive back the foe.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Gravis unit has shot. TARGET: That GRAVIS unit. EFFECT: Select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

stratagems.name: ANNIHILATING FORCE
stratagems.legend: Knowing well their duty to shatter the foe’s lines, these warriors strike with devastating strength.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly Gravis unit is selected to attack. TARGET: That GRAVIS unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks have [Lethal Hits].

stratagems.name: STAND UNYIELDING
stratagems.legend: Ground claimed by Gravis-clad Adeptus Astartes cannot be taken back with ease.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your Movement phase. TARGET: One friendly Gravis unit. EFFECT: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.

stratagems.name: DUTY UNTO DEATH
stratagems.legend: So driven by duty are the veterans of the Unforgiven that even death cannot keep them from it.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Deathwing unit. TARGET: That DEATHWING unit. EFFECT: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +1 to that roll if your unit is engaged with an enemy unit within range of your vowed objective: On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

stratagems.name: RELIC TELEPORTARIUM
stratagems.legend: The Deathwing employ ancient and incredibly powerful teleportariums, some older than the Great Crusade, to strike at their foes with unparalleled safety and accuracy.
