stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Deathwing unit with the Deep Strike ability is selected to make an ingress move. TARGET: That DEATHWING unit. EFFECT: Your unit can be set up more than 6" horizontally from all enemy units (instead of more than 8"). Your unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of this turn.

stratagems.name: WRATH OF THE LION
stratagems.legend: Channelling the strategic puissance and measured ferocity of their gene-sire, the veterans of the Unforgiven unleash a perfectly timed and utterly lethal storm of tightly controlled violence.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Charge phase, when a friendly Deathwing unit ends a charge move. TARGET: That DEATHWING unit. EFFECT: Select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. If you do, roll one D6 for each model in your unit engaged with that enemy unit: For each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).

stratagems.name: UPSTOPPABLE ADVANCE
stratagems.legend: Ruins, barricades, bunkers; few such structures can impede the relentless advance of an Adeptus Astartes Dreadnought.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly Dreadnought unit is selected to move or declares a charge. TARGET: That DREADNOUGHT unit. EFFECT: Your unit has Mobile.

stratagems.name: MERCY IS WEAKNESS
stratagems.legend: Once a foe is marked for destruction, the Angels of Death must not relent until the target is annihilated.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly Dreadnought unit is selected to attack. TARGET: That DREADNOUGHT unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks have: [lethal hits]. Or: [Sustained Hits 1].

stratagems.name: ADAMANTINE TERROR
stratagems.legend: Booming war cries through his vox-amplifiers, this Dreadnought rampages through the terrified foe.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Start of the Fight phase. TARGET: One friendly Dreadnought unit. EFFECT: Each enemy unit engaged with your unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

stratagems.name: LAYERED CERAMITE
stratagems.legend: The labours of artisans in the Chapter armoury now bear fruit.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Vehicle unit suffers a mortal wound. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit. EFFECT: Your unit has Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: MIGHT OF THE MACHINE SPIRIT
stratagems.legend: There are many tales of machine spirits wreaking havoc on the foe, even after the crews of their vehicles are slain.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Command phase. TARGET: One friendly Adeptus Astartes Vehicle unit (excluding Dedicated Transport/Fly/Walker units). EFFECT: Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit can ignore modifiers to your unit’s: M. BS. Hit rolls and wound rolls.

stratagems.name: HEADHUNTER DOCTRINE
stratagems.legend: Exhaustive tactical training aids Space Marine gunners in exploiting any weakness in their targets’ armour.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Vehicle unit (excluding Dedicated Transport/Fly/Walker units) is selected to shoot. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [Lethal Hits: Monster/Vehicle].

stratagems.name: UNSPARING EXECUTION
stratagems.legend: Those who attempt to flee their rightful death only stroke their executioners' hatred all the hotter. None can be spared the God-Emperor's wrath.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when a unit is selected to make a fall-back move, if that unit is engaged with a friendly Sword Brethren Squad unit. TARGET: That SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit. EFFECT: When an enemy unit engaged with your unit is selected to make a fall-back move , that enemy unit must use the desperate escape mode, with -1 to those hazard rolls if that enemy unit is battle-shocked.

stratagems.name: BLADE OF DETESTATION
stratagems.legend: With roared litanies and incendiary hatred, the Sword Brethren plunge into their foe like a white-hot blade, their armoured momentum cracking armour, crushing bones, and trampling the foe underfoot.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Charge phase, when a friendly Sword Brethren Squad unit ends a charge move. TARGET: That SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD. EFFECT: Select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. Roll one D6 for each model in your unit engaged with that enemy unit: For each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).

stratagems.name: SLAYERS OF ABOMINATIONS
stratagems.legend: The largest manifestations of the foe's sin are branded unholy abominations, challenges which a crusade's champions gladly meet to drive their sanctified weapons deeply beneath their hides.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly Sword Brethren Squad unit is selected to fight. TARGET: That SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks that target a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit have +2 S.

stratagems.name: SPIRITS OF IRON
stratagems.legend: These warriors emulate the mechanical monstrosities at whose side they fight, shrugging off wounds both physical and spiritual.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit suffers a mortal wound. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit. EFFECT: Your unit has Feel no pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: ANCIENT FURY
stratagems.legend: The heroes entombed within Dreadnoughts have fought across countless war zones throughout their extended existences, perfecting their martial prowess beyond mortal limits.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Command phase. TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES DREADNOUGHT unit. EFFECT: Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit has: +1" M. +1 T. +1 Ld. +1 OC. +1 to hit rolls.

stratagems.name: POWER OF THE MACHINE SPIRIT
stratagems.legend: There are many tales of machine spirits wreaking havoc on the foe, even after the crew of their vehicle are slain and critical systems are failing.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged Adeptus Astartes Vehicle unit has shot. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit. EFFECT: Your unit shoots using: Snap shooting. Or: If your unit is at half-strength/below half-strength, normal shooting. While doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.

stratagems.name: METHODICAL BRUTALITY
stratagems.legend: Once a foe is marked for destruction, the Angels of Death must not relent until the target is annihilated.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to attack. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. SECONDARY EFFECT: If your unit is a VEHICLE unit, have +1 to wound rolls.

stratagems.name: UNBOWED CONVICTION
stratagems.legend: Space Marines exemplify obdurate tenacity. Even severely injured, they will never abandon their oaths.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Command phase. TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit that is below starting strength. EFFECT: Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit can ignore modifiers to your unit’s: BS and WS. Hit rolls and Wound rolls.

stratagems.name: VENGEFUL ANIMUS
stratagems.legend: Carefully cogitated binharic prayers can focus a machine spirit’s ire into near-obsessive hatred of its slayers, ensuring that vengeance is meted out even in death.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit is destroyed, before rolling for deadly demise. TARGET: That friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit. EFFECT: Change any deadly demise rolls made for this unit to an unmodified 6.

stratagems.name: MORTIS SNARES
stratagems.legend: These stealth operatives lace the battlefield with explosive devices that trigger by mico-auspex and las-wire when foes blunder into them.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your Movement phase. TARGET: One friendly unengaged Phobos/Scout Squad unit. EFFECT: If your unit is controlling an objective, that objective is snared. While an objective is snared, when an enemy unit ends a move within range of that objective, roll one D6: On a 2+, that enemy unit suffers D6 mortal wounds. That objective is no longer snared.

stratagems.name: STRIKE FROM THE SHADOWS
stratagems.legend: To evade one’s enemies and sow confusion can be a deadly weapon in itself.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly hidden Phobos unit is selected to attack. TARGET: That PHOBOS unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks have: +1 S. [Lethal Hits].

stratagems.name: TACTICAL WITHDRAWAL
stratagems.legend: At an opportune moment, Space Marine infiltration units slip away from battle, only to relocate ready to strike the foe again.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase. TARGET: One friendly unengaged Phobos/Scout SQUAD unit. EFFECT: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

stratagems.name: STRIKE FROM THE SHADOWS
stratagems.legend: To evade one’s enemies and sow confusion can be a deadly weapon in itself.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly hidden Phobos unit is selected to attack. TARGET: That PHOBOS unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks have: +1 S. [Lethal Hits].

stratagems.name: UMBRAL EVASION
stratagems.legend: A combination of technological arcana and expert training help these warriors to evade the eyes of the foe.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Phobos unit. TARGET: That PHOBOS unit. EFFECT: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 to hit rolls.

stratagems.name: TRANSHUMAN REACTIONS
stratagems.legend: Seemingly with the speed of instinct, these warriors reposition in response to the enemy’s movements.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged Phobos unit. TARGET: That PHOBOS unit. EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of: Up to D6". Or: If the tactical doctrine is active for your unit, up to 6".

stratagems.name: MASTER MARKSMEN
stratagems.type: Pilum Strike Team – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Every shot these warriors fire is placed for maximum impact and swift, decisive kills.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase. TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.

stratagems.name: KNIFE WORK
stratagems.type: Pilum Strike Team – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.legend: These warriors strike at their enemies'weak spots, aiming to silence the foe without raising the alarm.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase. TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1.

stratagems.name: FIGHTING RETREAT
stratagems.type: Pilum Strike Team – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.legend: These warriors employ cover fire and frag charges to batter the foe as they fall back to new positions.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army is selected to Fall Back. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit. EFFECT: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit and roll one D6: on a 2-4, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on a 5+, that enemy unit suffers 2 mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: ENHANCED EFFICIENCY
stratagems.type: Pilum Strike Team – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Moving with alacrity, clearing each new space with exceptional speed and skill, the warriors of the strike team advance on their main objective.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase. TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit is selected to make a Normal or Advance move, it can attempt to operate one Hatchway it is within 1” of either at the start or end of that move. If it does, it cannot attempt to operate a Hatchway again this turn.

stratagems.name: CO-ORDINATED STRIKE
stratagems.legend: Space Wolves officers rein in their warriors’ impulsive fury, repositioning them to strike exposed flanks.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase. TARGET: One unengaged Blood Claws/Thunderwolf Cavalry/Wulfen unit that is within 9" of one or more battlefield edges. EFFECT: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

stratagems.name: IMPETUOSITY
stratagems.legend: Severe losses only drive Blood Claws and Wulfen forward into the midst of the foe.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged Blood Claws/Thunderwolf Cavalry/Wulfen unit has shot. TARGET: That BLOOD CLAWS/THUNDERWOLF CAVALRY/WULFEN unit. EFFECT: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

stratagems.name: UNBRIDLED FEROICITY
stratagems.legend: The Space Wolves fight with a savage fury that enables them to overcome even the most resilient targets.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly Blood Claws/Thunderwolf Cavalry/Wulfen unit is selected to fight. TARGET: That BLOOD CLAWS/THUNDERWOLF CAVALRY/WULFEN unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [LANCE].

stratagems.name: EYE OF THE PACK
stratagems.type: Saga of the Great Wolf Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Once a pack of Fenrisian warriors has perceived some slight weakness in the defences of a foe, they all strike at once, like encircling predators dragging down their prey.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, or the Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit is selected to attack. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1 and 2.

stratagems.name: FENRISIAN FEROCITY
stratagems.type: Saga of the Great Wolf Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Even the most challenging terrain or formidable fortifications cannot stop the Great Wolf’s chief hunters once they are in motion.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Mounted/Walker unit is selected to move or declares a charge. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/WALKER unit. EFFECT: Your unit has Mobile.

stratagems.name: GRIMNAR'S COMMAND
stratagems.type: Saga of the Great Wolf Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Pivotal as they are to the Great Wolf’s plans, this pack have their own orders to fulfil in this moment that come directly from Grimnar himself.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Command phase. TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit (excluding Monster/Vehicle units). EFFECT: Select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: BATTLE INSTINCTS
stratagems.type: Saga of the Great Wolf Stratagem
stratagems.legend: These champions of Fenris respond to enemy fire with instinctive swiftness, rarely giving their foes a second chance to shoot at them.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted unit has shot. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit. EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: FANGS OF THE PACK
stratagems.type: Saga of the Great Wolf Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Fighting as one, these champions of Fenris fall upon an enemy champion and drag them down with single-minded savagery.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted unit is selected to fight. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [Precision].

stratagems.name: WOLF TOTEMS
stratagems.type: Saga of the Great Wolf Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Be it the power of belief or something a little more eldritch, the Space Wolves’ trust in their various protective amulets and totems is often borne out.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted unit suffers a mortal wound. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit. EFFECT: Your unit has Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: RAPTORIAL VIGILANCE
stratagems.legend: The Raven Guard are swift to exploit the movements of their foes, whether to pursue their prey and complete the kill or to make use of an opportunity to fade once more from sight.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit. EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of: Up to D6". Or: If your unit is a Phobos/Scout Squad unit, up to 6".

stratagems.name: LAY LOW THE TYRANTS
stratagems.legend: In a storm of blade thrusts and bludgeoning strikes, enemy champions and commanders are laid low, leaving their troops in leaderless disarray.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit is selected to fight. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY. EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [Precision].

stratagems.name: FEINT AND THRUST
stratagems.legend: Retreating from the fight, these warriors lure their enemies on before swiftly turning the tables and hurling themselves into their now overextended foe.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Command phase. TARGET: One friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit. EFFECT: The tactical doctrine is active for your unit in addition to any other combat doctrine, until the start of your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: MURDEROUS FUSILLADE
stratagems.legend: From darkness and obscuring cover, Raven Guard battle-brothers open fire as one, striking their unaware targets with precision fire.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit that made an ingress move this turn is selected to shoot. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have: +1 BS. +1 AP.

stratagems.name: SUPPRESSED WEAPONS
stratagems.legend: The Raven Guard commonly utilise integral suppressors, flash-hiders and other technology to dampen weapon reports and conceal muzzle flare, enabling battle-brothers to fire on unsuspecting foes without giving away their positions.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit has shot. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit. EFFECT: Those attacks do not prevent your unit from being hidden.

stratagems.name: INTO DARKNESS
stratagems.legend: At the opportune moment, Raven Guard infiltration units slip away from battle, only to relocate ready to strike the foe again.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase. TARGET: One unengaged Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit. EFFECT: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

stratagems.name: ADAPTIVE PURGE
stratagems.type: Shield of the Void – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Whatever hidden horrors lurk in the vessels the Shield Chapters must conquer, the warriors are able to adapt their firing tactics to ensure their destruction.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase. TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase. EFFECT: Select one of the following abilities: [LETHAL HITS], [IGNORES COVER] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have that ability.

stratagems.name: RAPID TAKEOVER
stratagems.type: Shield of the Void – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.legend: With one foe reeling in disarray, the battle-brothers instantly refocus on their next target, their rapid yet methodical progress capitalising on the enemy's every move.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit Falls Back. TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was within Engagement Range of that enemy unit at the start of the phase. EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D3+1".

stratagems.name: OVERCHARGED BREACH
stratagems.type: Shield of the Void – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.legend: With a well-placed volley of high-powered ammunition or a dedicated melta charge, specially equipped Space Marines can effect a permanent access route.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Start of your Shooting phase. TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units. EFFECT: Select one closed Hatchway within 9" of and visible to your unit. Open that Hatchway and, until the end of the battle, that Hatchway cannot be closed. RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this Stratagem more than once.

stratagems.name: CODEX WARFARE
stratagems.type: Shield of the Void – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.legend: The Codex Astartes is held as a hallowed work of martial genius by the Shield Chapters. Its tenets prescribe tactical adaptability and fighting on the move, advancing from one adversary to the next in a series of deadly redeployments.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase. TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army. EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.

stratagems.name: FLAWLESS RIDERS
stratagems.legend: Skilled Space Marine riders can guide their steeds through even the densest and most treacherous terrain to strike their foes from the position they least expect.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes mounted unit is selected to move or declares a charge. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED unit. EFFECT: Your unit has Mobile.

stratagems.name: EVASIVE MANOEUVERS
stratagems.legend: Battle-brothers of the White Scars Chapter are born and raised in the saddle. Expert pilots and riders all, they weave through incoming fire with instinctive skill.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Adeptus Astartes Mounted/Speeder unit. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit. EFFECT: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 to wound rolls.

stratagems.name: SPEAR THRUST AND SABRE SWING
stratagems.legend: Some foes can be ended with a single charge. Others require sustained savagery to fell. The White Scars are adept at both methods of fighting.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks: Have [LETHAL HITS]. Or: Have [LANCE]. Or: If your unit has Mounted, have [LETHAL HITS] and [LANCE].

stratagems.name: WITHDRAW AND REGROUP
stratagems.legend: The riders and pilots sweep away as swiftly as they arrive, regrouping in preparation for their next assault.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase. TARGET: One friendly unengaged Adeptus Astartes Mounted/Speeder unit. EFFECT: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

stratagems.name: HUNTER'S INSTINCTS
stratagems.legend: The White Scars read the ebb and flow of battle with the hungry cunning of raptorial predators, reacting to the enemy’s movements with exceptional rapidity.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted/Speeder unit. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit. EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: MOBILE LETHALITY
stratagems.legend: The White Scars fight their wars at a furious tempo, and their warriors are adept at fire-and-manoeuvre strategies.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to make an advance/fall-back move. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit. EFFECT: That fall-back move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot. Your unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].

stratagems.name: SUDDEN ONSLAUGHT
stratagems.legend: Speed and shock are key to the Space Marine way of war: never more so than on rapid-strike missions.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Mounted/Speeder unit is selected to make an advance move. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit. EFFECT: Your unit can change its advance rolls to a 6.

stratagems.name: WIND-SWIFT EVASION
stratagems.legend: Employing their steeds’ pace to utmost effect, these warriors stay ever on the move.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of the Fight phase. TARGET: One friendly Adeptus Astartes Mounted unit that was eligible to fight this phase. EFFECT: If your unit is unengaged, your unit can make a normal move. Or: If your unit is engaged, your unit can make a fall-back move.

stratagems.name: HURTLING TARGETS
stratagems.legend: With nerves of steel and transhuman reactions, the Space Marines jink and weave cooly through incoming fire.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Adeptus Astartes Mounted/Speeder unit. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit. EFFECT: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 to hit rolls.

stratagems.name: MASTERFUL TACTICS
stratagems.legend: Such is the Space Marines’ grasp of adaptive tactics that even the most canny enemies soon find themselves out of position.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted unit. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit. EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of: Up to D6". Or: If the tactical doctrine is active for your unit, up to 6".

stratagems.name: DOMINATION FIRE
stratagems.legend: The Codex Astartes dictates when firepower is best used to dismay, disrupt and debilitate the enemy.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit has shot. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit. EFFECT: Select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit is suppressed until the start of your next turn: While a unit is suppressed, that unit’s attacks have -1 to hit rolls.

stratagems.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
stratagems.legend: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit. EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: TRANSHUMAN SWIFTNESS
stratagems.legend: Poised and aware of their foes’ every move, these warriors strike at the most tactically advantageous moment.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit has fought. TARGET: One friendly Tacticus unit that is within range of an objective and is eligible to fight. EFFECT: Your unit has Fights First and must be the next unit you select to fight.

stratagems.name: TACTICAL FOCUS
stratagems.legend: Even amidst the fiercest fighting, this squad retains sight of their assigned mission.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly Tacticus unit is selected to make a consolidation move. TARGET: That TACTICUS unit. EFFECT: When making that consolidation move, your unit can move up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: RELENTLESS ASSAULT
stratagems.legend: Pressing mercilessly forward, these warriors place shots and blows perfectly, no matter their targets.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly Tacticus unit is selected to attack. TARGET: That TACTICUS unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks have: [Sustained Hits 1: non-Monster/Vehicle]. Or: [Lethal Hits: Monster/Vehicle].

stratagems.name: FOR THE EMPEROR!
stratagems.legend: Unflinching in their loyalty to Chapter and Primarch, battle-brothers seize and hold their objectives with unrelenting determination and zealous fury.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Command phase. TARGET: One friendly Tacticus unit that is within range of an objective. EFFECT: Your unit has +1 OC until the end of the turn.

stratagems.name: POINT-BLANK BRUTALITY
stratagems.legend: Transhuman skill and reaction times render these Space Marines’ firearms as deadly up close as any blade.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly engaged Tacticus unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That TACTICUS unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks (excluding [Blast] attacks) have: [Close-Quarters]. [Ignores Cover].

stratagems.name: RELENTLESS ASSAULT
stratagems.legend: Pressing mercilessly forward, these warriors place shots and blows perfectly, no matter their targets.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly Tacticus unit is selected to attack. TARGET: That TACTICUS unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks have: [Sustained Hits 1: non-Monster/Vehicle]. Or: [Lethal Hits: Monster/Vehicle].

stratagems.name: CLEANSING SWEEP
stratagems.legend: Refined during the clearance of infested space hulks, these methodical tactics ensure no angle of approach goes undefended.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent's Movement or Charge phase. TARGET: One Terminator Squad unit from your army that has not fired Overwatch this phase. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack while firing Overwatch, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ is required to score a hit, instead of an unmodified 6.

stratagems.name: TOWER OF STRENGTH
stratagems.legend: Each individual Terminator is a walking fortress. When they stand together they are truly indomitable.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Start or end of any phase. TARGET: One Adeptus Astartes Terminator unit from your army. EFFECT: Until the end of your next Command phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in your unit. RESTRICTIONS: Each time you use this Stratagem, you cannot use it again until after your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: CARVE A PATH
stratagems.legend: Power fists, chainfists, and sheer servo-actuated armoured mass ensure that Terminators’ paths are never barred for long.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase. TARGET: One Terminator Assault Squad unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase and has not declared a charge this phase. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, when making a Normal, Advance or Charge move, your unit can move through a single closed Hatchway as if it was open. When doing so, that Hatchway is opened and cannot be closed for the rest of the battle. This can allow that unit to declare a charge against enemy units that are not visible to it, but to do so those enemy units must be within 1" of that Hatchway and wholly on the opposite side of it from your unit. RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this Stratagem more than once per turn.

stratagems.name: FOCUSING SHRINE
stratagems.legend: An ancient device built into the structure of the teleportarium, this relic allows for incredibly accurate teleport assaults.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase, at the start of the Reinforcements step. TARGET: One Adeptus Astartes Terminator unit from your army that is in Reserves. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, when setting up your unit on the battlefield using its Deep Strike ability, you can set it up unit anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy models (measure this distance as you would normally for the Deep Strike ability, ignoring Walls and closed Hatchways). RESTRICTIONS: Until the end of the turn, your unit is not eligible to declare a charge.

stratagems.name: GUNSHIP EXTRACTION
stratagems.legend: Armoured gunships are often assigned to swoop in and relocate Terminator Squads in the midst of battle.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase. TARGET: One friendly unengaged adeptus astartes terminator unit. EFFECT: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

stratagems.name: MERCILESS VETERANS
stratagems.legend: Cumulative centuries of military experience help these veterans’ firepower hit home with murderous precision.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly adeptus astartes Terminator unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have: [Lethal Hits]. [Sustained Hits 1].

stratagems.name: TACTICAL DREADNOUGHT FORTITUDE
stratagems.legend: The combination of Tactical Dreadnought armour and transhuman physiology is redoubtable indeed.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly adeptus astartes Terminator unit. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit. EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 D until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: DREAD CRUSADERS
stratagems.legend: To face the Emperor’s transhuman crusaders as they chant their litanies of detestation can chill the soul.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Charge phase, when an enemy unit selects charge targets. TARGET: One Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit that was selected as a charge target by that enemy unit this phase. EFFECT: That enemy unit must make a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

stratagems.name: SPOOR OF THE UNHOLY
stratagems.legend: Perhaps guided by visions from the Emperor, Black Templars can pick out heresy wherever it lurks.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to attack. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit. EFFECT: Your unit can ignore modifiers to your unit’s: BS and WS. Hit rolls.

stratagems.name: DEVOUT PUSH
stratagems.legend: With a zealous cry, the Black Templars press forward, using their ceramite-armoured bulk to smash into the foe and overwhelm the enemy’s lines.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit is selected to make a pile-in/consolidation move. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit. EFFECT: When making that pile-in/consolidation move, your unit can move up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: PIOUS ENMITY
stratagems.legend: The warrior priests of a crusade drive Sigismund’s heirs into the heart of battle, daring the greatest abominations to face their spiritual strength.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly Chaplain/Judiciar unit is selected to fight. TARGET: That CHAPLIN/JUDICIAR unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1. Or: Your unit’s melee attacks that target a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit can re-roll hit rolls of 1 and wound rolls of 1.

stratagems.name: HERESY BEGETS RETRIBUTION
stratagems.legend: Where enemies dare threaten the warriors of the God-Emperor or seek to escape their deserved death, there must be swift retribution.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit. EFFECT: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

stratagems.name: FOR THE EMPEROR'S HONOUR!
stratagems.legend: Filled with the spirit of Sigismund, his heirs seek out the foe’s dark and unclean champions so that they may be crushed in the sight of their thralls.
stratagems.description: WHEN: The Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit is selected to fight. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [PRECISION].

stratagems.name: DEATH BEGETS VENGEANCE
stratagems.legend: With their perceptions twisted, the battle-brothers of the Death Company transmute loss into the worst of ancient betrayals and seek only to sever such treachery from existence.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly Death Company unit is destroyed by an enemy unit. TARGET: That enemy unit. EFFECT: That enemy unit is hated until the end of the battle: While a unit is hated, friendly DEATH COMPANY units’ attacks that target that unit have +1 to wound rolls.

stratagems.name: NO BARRIER TO RETRIBUTION
stratagems.legend: Knowing in what remains of his mind that his is a sorrow-filled mission of galactic consequence, this ancient interred warrior permits nothing to stand in his way.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement or your Charge phase, when a friendly Death Company Dreadnought unit is selected to make a normal/advance/charge move. TARGET: That DEATH COMPANY DREADNOUGHT unit. EFFECT: Your unit has Mobile.

stratagems.name: RAGE-FUELLED RESPONSE
stratagems.legend: They may no longer recognise the foe before them, but the Lost Brethren are sane enough to identify an attack and capable of responding with a violent surge and a howl of wrath.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged Death Company unit has shot. TARGET: That DEATH COMPANY unit. EFFECT: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

stratagems.name: IN SACRIFICE, VICTORY
stratagems.legend: Those inducted into the Dark Angels’ Inner Circle will gladly give their lives in pursuit of victory, and to see the Fallen brought to justice.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly Deathwing/Ravenwing unit within range of an objective is destroyed. TARGET: That DEATHWING/RAVENWING unit. You can target that unit with this stratagem even though it is destroyed. EFFECT: Select one objective: That no enemy units (excluding AIRCRAFT units) are within range of. That your unit was controlling at the end of the previous phase. That objective is secured.

stratagems.name: KNIGHTS OF IRON
stratagems.legend: Atop their snarling mechanical steeds, the warriors of the Ravenwing surge through seemingly impassable terrain, smashing through rubble and ruin to unleash the wrath of the Unforgiven upon unsuspecting targets.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly Ravenwing unit is selected to move or declares a charge. TARGET: That RAVENWING unit. EFFECT: Your unit has Mobile.

stratagems.name: RELICS OF THE DARK AGE
stratagems.legend: Amongst the many secrets hoarded by the Dark Angels are those technological in nature. The armouries of the Rock contain potent weapons unseen in the armouries of other Chapters.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have +2 S.

stratagems.name: TACTICAL MASTERY
stratagems.legend: When the constituent elements of the Dark Angels fight as one, the enemy is often overwhelmed and torn apart by the Chapter’s tactical flexibility and mastery of rapid warfare.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Command phase. TARGET: One friendly Deathwing/Ravenwing unit. EFFECT: Select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: INESCAPABLE JUSTICE
stratagems.legend: The Dark Angels are relentless in the pursuit of their foes, striking with ruthless ferocity and precision to take the heads of those who have crossed the Chapter.
stratagems.description: WHEN: The Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes unit is selected to fight. TARGET: That Adeptus Astartes unit. EFFECT: Your unit's melee attacks have [Precision].

stratagems.name: LION'S WILL
stratagems.legend: Unflinching in their loyalty to Chapter and Primarch, Dark Angels battle-brothers seize and hold their objectives with unrelenting determination and zealous fury.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Command phase. TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit that is within range of an objective. EFFECT: Your unit has +1 OC until the end of the turn.

abilities.name: Space Marine Chapters
abilities.legend: The many Chapters of Space Marines are spread perilously thin across the Imperium’s countless war zones. Though it is not unheard of for them to fight alongside one another on the same battlefield, far more commonly their strike forces operate alone to defeat seemingly impossible odds.
abilities.description: If an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit has a second Faction keyword on its datasheet, that Faction keyword is the name of that unit’s Chapter. For example, Marneus Calgar has both the ADEPTUS ASTARTES and ULTRAMARINES Faction keywords,and is therefore from the Ultramarines Chapter. You cannot include units from more than one Chapter in your army.

abilities.name: Assigned Agents
abilities.legend: Throughout the Imperium there exist numerous martial organisations and shadowy institutions. Bodies of armed warriors or solitary agents from these groups possess specialist skills, unusual equipment and vested interests that lead them to be attached to larger Imperial armies. Some are requisitioned by the army’s commander for their particular abilities, others are assigned by their hidden masters to achieve singular agendas. The most powerful have the authority and reputation to enforce their presence on the field of battle.
abilities.description: If your Army Faction is AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM, then in the Select Detachment Rules step, you can select one of the available Detachments from this book as normal. If your Army Faction is not AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM, but every model in your army has the IMPERIUM keyword, you can include AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM units in your army even if they do not have the Faction keyword you selected in the Select Army Faction step. In this case, the maximum number of AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM units you can include in your army depends on the battle size, as shown below. BATTLE SIZERETINUE UNITSCHARACTER UNITSREQUISITIONED UNITSIncursion111Strike Force221Onslaught332 Note that you can include AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM DEDICATED TRANSPORT units in such an army as normal, but each unit must start the battle with one or more units embarked within it, or it cannot be deployed for that battle and will count as having been destroyed during the first battle round.

abilities.name: Kill Team
abilities.description: Each time an attack targets this unit, if it contains models with different Toughness characteristics, until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, use the Toughness characteristic of the majority of the models in that unit when determining what roll is required for that attack to successfully wound. If two or more Toughness characteristics are tied for majority, use the highest value. For the purposes of determining which models in this unit can embark within a Transport, Kill Team Terminator models, Kill Team Outrider models, Kill Team Biker models and models equipped with a jump pack each take up the space of 2 models, but can otherwise embark within any TRANSPORT their unit can embark within, even though similar models in other units have the Terminator, Mounted or Jump Pack keywords. For the purposes of interacting with terrain features, all models in units with this ability are considered INFANTRY models, even though similar models in other units may have the MOUNTED or JUMP PACK keywords. Designer’s Note: While the abstractions in the above rule cause some models to behave differently to similar models in other units, they are designed to minimise complicated movement, TRANSPORT and Benefit of Cover rules.

abilities.name: The Ravenwing
abilities.description: The following friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units have RAVENWING: MOUNTED units. VEHICLE FLY units.

abilities.name: The Deathwing
abilities.description: The following friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units have DEATHWING: TERMINATOR units. BLADEGUARD ANCIENT, BLADEGUARD VETERAN SQUAD, STERNGUARD VETERAN SQUAD and VANGUARD VETERAN SQUAD WITH JUMP PACKS units. LAND RAIDER, LAND RAIDER CRUSADER, LAND RAIDER REDEEMER, REPULSOR and REPULSOR EXECUTIONER units. DREADNOUGHT units.

abilities.name: Curse of the Wulfen
abilities.legend: Only while fighting at the side of their battle-brothers can the feral Wulfen control their frenzied aggression.
abilities.description: While this unit is within 6" of a friendly SPACE WOLVES CHARACTER model (excluding WULFEN models) or within 12" of a friendly WOLF PRIEST model, if this unit is not battle-shocked: If this unit has INFANTRY, this unit has +1 OC. If this unit has VEHICLE, this unit has +3 OC. Bestial Forms: For the purposes of transport capacity, each WULFEN model takes up the space of 2 models.

abilities.name: Sons of Russ
abilities.description: Your army cannot include APOTHECARY units.

abilities.name: Heirs of Sigismund
abilities.description: Your army cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER models. Your army cannot include the following datasheets from Codex: Space Marines: GLADIATOR LANCER; GLADIATOR REAPER; GLADIATOR VALIANT; IMPULSOR; REPULSOR; REPULSOR EXECUTIONER.

abilities.name: Combat Doctrines
abilities.legend: The Space Marines draw upon the combat doctrines of the Codex Astartes as they flow through each phase of battle: first hammering the enemy with devastating firepower, then raking them with close-ranged volleys while manoeuvring to deliver a final, crushing assault.
abilities.description: At the start of your Command phase, you can select one combat doctrine listed below. If you do, that combat doctrine is active for friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units with this ability until the start of your next Command phase. ASSAULT DOCTRINEWhen this unit is selected to make an advance move, that advance move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to declare a charge. DEVASTATOR DOCTRINEThis unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT]. TACTICAL DOCTRINEWhen this unit is selected to make a fall-back move, that fall-back move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to shoot and eligible to declare a charge. Unless otherwise stated: You can only select each combat doctrine once per battle. Only one combat doctrine can be active for each unit. If a rule makes a combat doctrine active for a unit, any combat doctrine previously active for that unit is no longer active for that unit.

abilities.name: Transhuman Strategist
abilities.legend: Those Space Marines who rise to positions of command are exceptional strategists and tacticians.
abilities.description: At the start of the battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, gain 1CP.

abilities.name: Librarius
abilities.legend: Space Marine Librarians advance through the ranks of Lexicanum, then Codicier, then Epistolary, their psychic might and repertoire of powers increasing with their hardwon experience.
abilities.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER units with this ability have a psyker level of 1 or higher, specified in that unit’s abilities. Each psychic ability has a psychic level of 1 or higher, specified in that ability’s name. In a battle round, a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER unit can use a number of psychic abilities whose total psychic level does not exceed that PSYKER unit’s psyker level. Example: In a battle round, a psyker level 3 PSYKER unit could use three psychic level 1 abilities, or one psychic level 1 ability and one psychic level 2 ability, or one psychic level 3 ability.

abilities.name: Veteran Recruits
abilities.description: Your army cannot include the following ADEPTUS ASTARTES units: SCOUT SQUAD units. TERMINATOR SQUAD units. TERMINATOR ASSAULT SQUAD units.
